title: Validate the LINK stationary-point handoff for KINETICS
summary: Validate the LINK stationary-point handoff for KINETICS. The contract registers the existing owner API and does not certify the accuracy of a particular molecular calculation.
gates: Require convergence, exact Hessian, one imaginary frequency and exact mode overlap
Require verified IRC connectivity and distinct endpoints
This acceptance stage validates the handoff and does not calculate a reaction rate
coordinate_policy: Preserve the ordered molecular identity, isotope masses, coordinate frame and declared owner representation; no geometry remapping or method substitution is implicit.
backend_policy: The scientific owner validates the inputs and numerical controls. Any missing electronic-structure acquisition uses the separately authorized calculation gateway; registration alone launches nothing.
